note: Music bed for 'Every Spider-Man 2 Boss Fight, Ranked by Story' (2026-11-18). Epic cinematic orchestra chosen per chapter by the agent (Bryce, 2026-11-12), from the three tracks on private B2: Last Dawn (theme) for the open, the top-four turn, the payoffs and the recap; Epic and Dramatic Trailer Music (tension) under the fights; Red (home) for the personal beats (MJ after Scream, Peter and Harry, Kraven's wish, Miles letting go, the outro). Never the game's own soundtrack. Levels as Spider-Man 2: under_narration_db -23, under_game_db -30. Sections start at a beat; offset is seconds into the track; gain_db overrides the level.
tracks_note: B2 keys in the private bucket (licensed tracks stay out of the public repo).
